create_skip_layer_guidance: create a SkipLayerGuidance instance with guidance scale, skip layer indices, and scale parameters for diffusion model inference
apply_skip_layer_guidance: apply skip layer guidance to a denoiser by preparing models, running forward pass, and cleaning up hooks
configure_skip_layer_guidance: configure skip layer guidance with LayerSkipConfig specifying transformer block indices to skip during denoising
combine_cfg_and_slg: combine classifier-free guidance and skip layer guidance in a single forward pass for improved image generation
enable_skip_layer_guidance: enable skip layer guidance within a step range by setting start and stop fractions of total denoising steps
